svg.title: External API (ESPN Proxy) Complete Data Flow (DNS → TLS → Gateway Policy Override → External API Proxy)

g.text: External API (ESPN Proxy) Complete Data Flow
(DNS → TLS → Gateway Policy Override → External API Proxy)
- Manages DNS records via Route53 API
- Proxies requests to external ESPN API
- Single entry point for external data
• AWS Load Balancer: Outside OpenShift Cluster
• Gateway deny-all + Route allow = selective override
• Clean separation of internal vs external data sources
② HTTPS Request to external-api hostname
④ TLS passthrough (Router → Gateway via OpenShift Route)
⑦ Forward to ESPN Proxy backend
⑧ Backend makes external API call
⑩ Backend returns data to browser
